ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee; close the dispute and inform the rider the fee stands (NS-1 satisfied: arrival confirmed 13:02:35, waited >3 min at the pickup until cancellation at 13:05:30).
ruling.reasoning: Service type RydeX (non-metered), driver cancelled while claiming rider no-show, so the case enters via NS-0 → NS-1. Element check: (i) arrival confirmed — the timeline's driver_pressed_here_at = 13:02:35 (recorded as a driver tap; no real value, but no explicit platform_auto flag and the driver states he pressed it, chat at 13:02:45 "Reached … waiting at the pickup"). (ii) Location at that moment — driver_pressed_here_at is 2 min 35 s after driver_arrived_at (13:01:00, GPS 1.35173,103.943272, ~0.2 km from the pickup point 1.3525,103.9447) and the GPS samples immediately before and after (13:02:00 at 1.353075,103.944617; 13:02:30 at 1.352366,103.944349) put the car beside the pickup within the 200 m arrival radius. (iii) Continuous wait beyond 3 minutes — GPS is stationary at 1.3524,103.9444 with speed ≈ 1–2 km/h from 13:02:30 through the 13:05:30 cancel timestamp (~180 s after the 13:02:35 tap, i.e. right at/just past the >3:00 threshold; the driver's 13:05:20 chat "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" corroborates and the trace shows no gap — nothing exceeding twice the sampling interval, so no G12 issue). There is no hole in the GPS and the trace covers up to the cancellation, so the wait cannot be inferred only between samples but is directly observed. Given the tap at 13:02:35 preceded by >90 s already stationary at the pickup (from ~13:01:30), the driver's own timed declaration is consistent with a wait in excess of 3 minutes until cancel. All three NS-1 conditions therefore hold and the $6.61 cancellation fee is valid → no_action. The rider's own words ("came out a minute after the driver cancelled") confirm the cancellation had already occurred, so the fee does not fail on the "≤3 min" branch of NS-2; no GPS-on-cancel discrepancy exists (trace ~35 m from pickup at 13:05:30), so no NS-2 flag_account. RD-6 is not applicable: this is a no-show, not a route-deviation case with a refund or an RD-1 breach. Safety screen: chat and statements contain no threat, abuse, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider's claim that she was charged 'for nothing' fails: the GPS trace shows the driver stationary at the pickup from ~13:01:30, arriving/pressing 'I'm Here' at 13:02:35 and remaining until cancellation at 13:05:30, i.e. an in-radius wait of more than 3 minutes, satisfying NS-1. Her statement that she emerged a minute after the cancellation concedes the fee was imposed during her absence.
